note: Edges use existing atlas nodes interference and superposition.

description.zh: 双缝条纹间距 Δy = λL/d，被单缝 sinc² 包络罩住；一颗颗粒子的落点累积成条纹，知道走了哪条缝则条纹消失（V² + D² ≤ 1）；物质波长 λ = h/(mv)。理想相干远场模型，不对“测量”做解释。
description.en: Double-slit fringes are spaced Δy = λL/d under a single-slit sinc² envelope; single particles build the fringes dot by dot, and knowing which slit was used erases them (V² + D² ≤ 1); matter waves have λ = h/(mv). An ideal coherent far-field model that offers no interpretation of measurement.

label.en: Path difference decides bright and dark

reason.zh: 两条缝到屏上一点的路程差等于波长整数倍时加强、半整数倍时抵消，这是干涉的路程差规则在双缝上的应用。
reason.en: The path difference from two slits to a screen point being a whole number of wavelengths reinforces and half-integers cancel, the path-difference rule of interference applied to a double slit.

reason.zh: 单个粒子也走出干涉条纹，说明两条路径的“振幅”先相加再取平方；一旦路径可区分，就改为概率相加，条纹消失。
reason.en: Single particles still build interference fringes, which shows that the amplitudes of two paths add before squaring; once the paths are distinguishable, probabilities add instead and the fringes vanish.

title.zh: 为什么一个电子也会“同时”走两条缝？
title.en: Why does a single electron behave as if it takes both slits?
